integrity: Exact analytic proof for all permitted parameters; 1,971 supporting checks, including exact rational identities and approximate numerical optimizations. Novelty is assessed from listed material, not independently certified. No human or independent external audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Complete bipartite support with self-loops and at least two vertices in each part, reversibility, stationarity uniform within each part. No extension to arbitrary per-vertex masses, sparse support, nonreversible dynamics or total-variation mixing time.
title: Unique fastest-mixing reversible walks on two-mass complete bipartite graphs
